note: ROOM 3 INTERACTION IDENTITIES. The two canonical speaking characters of the Nugget are PAINTED INTO THE PLATE and carry an invisible AmbientFile each, because Interactable has no `tree` field and a dialogue tree opens only from AmbientFile.tree. This route proves the four things that architecture has to get right for each of them: TALK TO resolves over the painted man, his canonical tree opens, the first speech is anchored over his painted head, and no duplicate art appears at any point. It also proves the group hotspot still answers beside them, and that leaving and re-entering the room leaves no ghost.
